wiki.title: Heath Flora
wiki.extract: Heath Hubert Flora (born July 19, 1983) is an American politician in the California State Assembly. He represents the northern San Joaquin Valley, including the cities of Manteca and Lodi. Flora served as the Minority Leader of the California State Assembly from September 16, 2025 to August 3, 2026.
